correctness.rationale: Precisely one length-three reversal copy is appended to its source factor, with no complement or wraparound. Cancelling untouched prefix/suffix gives AB=BV^R even for overlapping factors. Gaps 1 and 2 force a constant span. At gap d≥3, B must be a prefix of A repeated; the tail condition requires the rotation of A by d modulo 3 to be palindromic. A nonconstant A has at most one such rotation. A gap d≥6 cannot join consecutive indices in an equality class because d−3 gives the same collision. The residual nonconstant gaps 3, 4, 5 give exactly abaaba, baaaaba, bbaabbab, and the unique possible residue prevents an intervening collision. Constant consecutive collisions are exactly the gap-one aaaa windows. Each equality class contributes size minus one consecutive edges; subtracting all edges therefore handles multiple collisions without overcounting. Window probabilities q^(−3) and (q−1)/q^(d+2) give the mean by linearity, including absent patterns at small n. The frozen verifier and metadata were inspected, not executed. A separately written bounded exact check tested direct descendants, consecutive collision edges and rational means on 23,452 words (q=2 through n=12, q=3 through n=8, q=4 through n=6; starting at n=3). Replay: /workspace/branches/bd9fa510-af55-420e-bcc8-8b4fda581296/reproduce_pal3.py. The all-length conclusion uses the proof, not that finite test.

value.rationale: Length three is the first case beyond the known exact short-length sphere calculations in which separated nonconstant collisions obstruct a run-only formula. The exact finite-motif census is an input-dependent quantity relevant to one-error sphere calculations, eliminates duplicate counting from long collision chains, and gives an exact average without needing a model for dependent overlapping windows.
